notes.title: Skinwalker Hunt early access release date announcement!
notes.notes:
My new horror hunting game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/993110/Skinwalker_Hunt/]Skinwalker Hunt[/url] will be released into steam early access on [b]June 4[/b], 2021.

I want to use this opportunity to say thank you to all playtesters who helped me significantly improve the quality of the game.

Recently I've uploaded new screenshot from Skinwalker Hunt. Here's it is if you haven't seen it.

notes.title: About achievements and release date.
notes.notes:
I plan to release Shadows Peak out of early access on March 13 with a 33% discount.

I also plan to add achievements to the game in a week or two. Because of this, soon you might see information that Shadows Peak contains a lot of hidden achievements on steam. Those achievements will be added to steam and partially hidden for test purposes. Unfortunately steam doesn’t allow to completely hide this information from a player. Current version of the game can’t trigger them, so don’t think that it’s a bug. I will post an announcement when version of the game that can trigger them will be uploaded to steam. If you have any ideas for interesting achievements, you can post it in comments below or on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/359940/discussions/]Shadows Peak steam forum[/url].

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

notes.title: Final Chapter status update
notes.notes:
I know that a lot of you want to know about the progress on the final chapter and some of you even think that I've abandoned Shadows Peak. Well, that is not the case. I'm actively working on the final chapter almost every day and this is my full time job. 

In fact, final chapter has been playable from start to finish for some time. It isn't released to the public, because right now it's in the middle of playtesting stage, where playtesters play and I improve the game based on their feedback. Follow the link for more details on my playtesting process if you're interested. http://vintsevych.com/?p=1034 

I also plan to add a short playable section between the two chapters, currently codenamed prologue, to make the story of the final chapter more clear. 

I don't provide specific dates because it's just too damn hard to predict those and I don't want to set false expectations or sacrifice quality to hit a specific date. Here are some screenshots from the final chapter.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8770435/5ddf9eeed9216d8604de56d38331d909b071eb7a.jpg[/img]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8770435/191e3195b000f26fe1df3881917a749e5a63fbd1.jpg[/img]

Happy Holidays and Happy New Year!

notes.title: Version 0.389 is now live!
notes.notes:
This is a small update to tackle some bugs in chapter one. Work on chapter two continues. Version 0.388 contained a bug, that's why it was pulled from steam.

- Stamina increased.
- Boulders from explosion could block path in cave. This is fixed.
- It was possible to not receive important sms in cave. This is now fixed.
- Player can no longer interact with the [spoiler]body[/spoiler] inside the cabin through the window.
- Other small changes and improvements.

notes.title: Version 0.387 is now live!
notes.notes:
Work on chapter two continues, but there were enough improvements in chapter one to warrant a new patch.
 
- Decor improvements.
- Reduced amount of memory used by the game. 
- Changed amount of health points received from medkits and [spoiler]white shadows[/spoiler]. 
- Fixed main menu bug reported by Biblicalreaper. 
- Fixed an issue where the game sometimes asked the player to get a flashlight while the player already has one. 
- Fixed rare crash when player is leaving the cave.
- Small changes and improvements.

p.s. Because of chapter two development, there was a lot of new bugs that needed to be squashed to make 0.387 happen. I want to thank EeuorT and Daniel Maloney for taking the time to find all those bugs.

notes.title: Version 0.381 is now live!
notes.notes:
Work on chapter two continues, but there was enough improvements in chapter one to warrant new patch.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Added low quality trees option for low-end computers. This will make trees look ugly, so you should use it only if changing other settings don't bring desired fps.
- Physics configured to behave more realistic and less floaty.
- Combination of low quality settings and high field of view, caused some objects to disappear at a short distance. This is now fixed. 
- Optimization of main level.
- Fixed some bugs in save & load system, that could cause problems for people who want to replay the game.
- [spoiler]Guy in a cabin, can now only be killed with knife.[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]Moved bag with a lighter to a more visible place.[/spoiler]
- Other small gameplay improvements.
